# Job for Sol 6.1 Ultra: independent-teacher data pipeline (6 hours)

Repo: couns0538-sketch/dwqww. Your first NNUE job is accepted as complete (FINAL_REPORT at 27070fe). Do NOT retrain on the old data.

## Time limit
You have 6 hours total. At about 5h30 stop starting new work, push what is finished, and write the handoff. Push in this order so an early stop still leaves usable output: (1) data manifest and trainer, (2) the dataset, (3) the net-only branch (only if it qualifies, see below). Push a small progress note at least every hour so we can see where things are.

## Main job (do this first)
1. Build a clean dataset of at least 5M positions from fresh, game-identified self-play: Forge vs Forge and Forge vs 5101c252 (forge/6.4-hourly-20261019), varied openings. Every row carries its game ID.
2. Split train / validation by whole game, never by position. Hold out a final audit set of whole games and freeze it before training.
3. Label with a teacher that is NOT Forge's own 5000-node search: an independent engine (for example Stockfish at a fixed depth, run only as an external tool, no code copied into our repo) or a much deeper search. Blend the game result in at about 30-50%. Record teacher, settings and blend in the data manifest.
4. Train once on the existing 768->128x2 SCReLU residual architecture and the existing export format. Pre-register the epoch selection rule and freeze it before the audit, as you did before.
5. Push a net-only branch (only src/nnue_weights.inc changes) ONLY if audit loss beats the shipped net with a 95% whole-game bootstrap interval that excludes 0. Otherwise push only the dataset, manifest and trainer, and say so plainly.
6. Fix the licence on train_nnue.py and the SHA mismatch against SHA256SUMS.
7. Run no matches and make no Elo claims. Our PC gates every net with 1000-game SPRT.

## Optional second job (only if time remains after the main job is pushed)
Add 8 output buckets by piece count, end to end, on a separate branch off 6.4.24: nnue.cpp and the .inc format, a bucketed trainer and exporter, and a 10k-position C++ parity test. It must pass perft and the existing tests, and cost at most 5% speed (bench nps). Take the idea only, write your own code. Do not mix it into the data branch.

## Rules
- Do not touch src/ except src/nnue_weights.inc (main job) or the second-job branch.
- Keep documentation short: one FINAL_REPORT.md of at most 2 pages plus the manifest. No 300-file evidence dumps.
- Take ideas only from other engines, never copy code or GPL text.
- Report exact numbers (loss values, intervals, row counts, SHA256 of every artifact). Say "unproven" for anything not tested in games.
